name: Acid Vial
maneuver: Pouring the vial onto a surface destroys up to 1 cubic foot of mundane matter.
action: Make a ranged 5 attack using Agility.

name: Strong Acid Vial
maneuver: Pouring the vial onto a surface destroys up to 5 cubic feet of mundane matter.
action: Make a ranged 5 attack using Agility.

name: Blood Concoction
description: Unique Item | XP: 500.
maneuver: Consume the potion and make a Strength RR.

rrTable.tier1: Your lower body is now a slug tail. Your speed is reduced by 2.
rrTable.tier2: You gain both the tier 1 and 3 results.
rrTable.tier3: Your eyes are compound and you can see in the dark.

name: Fire Bomb
action: Throw the bomb up to 10 squares. It explodes in a 3 cube. Each creature in the cube must make an Agility RR.

name: Glue Pot
maneuver: Spread over a 2x2 area of ground. Creatures entering make a Strength RR.

name: Healing Potion
maneuver: Consume to regain 1d6 Stamina or remove 1 wound if Stamina is already at maximum.

name: Oil Flask
maneuver: Refuel a lantern, or spread over a 2x2 area of ground. Creatures entering the spread area make an Agility RR. The area is flammable; if lit, it burns for 1d6 combat rounds and a creature in the fire at the end of their turn takes 1d6 dam.

rrTable.tier2: Lose 2 squares of movement this turn

name: Poison Vial
maneuver: Apply to a weapon or 1 ammo. The next time it deals damage to a creature before the DT's end, they make a Strength RR.

name: Strong Poison
maneuver: Apply to a weapon or 1 ammo. The next time it deals damage to a creature before the DT's end, they make a Strength RR.

name: Rage Potion
maneuver: Consume to gain +5 AD and deal an additional 2 damage with melee attacks. Lasts as long as you keep making attacks against creatures each round.

name: Smoke Bomb
maneuver: Throw the bomb up to 10 squares. It explodes, creating a 3-cube area of heavy concealment. It becomes light concealment in d6 combat rounds, then dissipates in d6 more rounds.

name: Speed Potion
maneuver: Consume to increase your speed by 1. Duration: 1 UD.

name: Soothing Candy
maneuver: Consume a candy to remove 1 boned level from yourself.

name: Hearty Ration
description: When you consume this ration during a rest, you remove 1 additional wound.

name: Boom Wand
action: Create a 5 cube of fire within 15 squares of you. Each creature in the area must make an Agility RR.

name: Death's Ring
action: Choose an undead within 10 squares of you to make a Mind RR.

rrTable.tier1: The undead teleports next to you and then can counter.
rrTable.tier2: You control the undead for 1 combat round.
rrTable.tier3: You control the undead until the end of the DT.

name: Hurling Wand
maneuver: Target a creature within 15 squares of you. They make a Strength RR.

name: Life Ring
maneuver: Regain 1d6 Stamina, end a condition affecting you, or heal 1 wound.

name: Minor Telekinesis Ring
action: Pick an unattended Small or smaller object within 10 squares of you. Vertically slide that object up to 10 squares.

name: Necklace of Teeth
description: While you wear this necklace, your unarmed strikes deal an additional 1 dam.

name: Plague Mask
description: While you wear the mask, you have a +2 bonus on Mind RRs made to resist the effects of the Miasma.

name: Whistle of Dog Summoning
action: Blow this whistle and summon a dog who is your pet. The dog disappears at the end of the DT or if their Stamina drops to 0.

name: Alteration Stone
description: Choose one benefit when you make the stone. The creature carrying it gains it: you don't need to eat or drink to live; you don't need to breathe to live; or the stone sheds light 5/5.

name: Animal Form Book
description: You gain the stats and form of an animal. Your gear is assumed by your form. If you die, you revert back. Your animal form's maximum power is based on the casting.

name: Repair Book
description: You touch a damaged object and cause it to regain Stamina based on the casting.

name: Take Shape Book
description: You attempt to change your form to match a creature.

rrTable.tier2: You look like them but gain no stats other than their size
rrTable.tier3: You gain their size, speed, and Stamina

name: Minor Blessing Book
description: Each target of the spell is blessed. The number of targets depends on the casting.

name: Minor Healing Book
description: Target regains Stamina based on the casting.

name: Minor Ward Book
description: Target gains AD based on the casting.

name: Jaunt Book
description: You teleport a number of squares based on the casting.

name: Teleport Object Book
description: You teleport the target a number of squares based on the casting. You can teleport it into a willing creature's open hand slot, including yours.

name: Summon Object Book
description: You create a mundane object that appears in any open slot in your inventory and lasts for the duration. The value of the object in gc is based on the casting.

name: Create Water Book
description: You make water that fills a vessel or falls from the air. The amount you make is based on the casting.

name: Cacophony Book
description: You create a phantom noise of your choice for the duration that emanates from a square within range. The distance at which it can be heard (in squares) is based on the casting.

name: Light Book
description: The object sheds light. The brightness of the light depends on the casting.

name: Minor Phantasm Book
description: You create a silent phantom image of your choice for the duration within a space within range. The maximum size of the image is based on the casting.

name: Monster Sense Book
description: You know the exact location of creatures who aren't humans or animals within a number of squares of you based on the casting. You can detect them through walls, floors, and ceilings.

name: Shrink Book
description: The target and their equipment size are reduced by a number of categories and weapon attack damage takes a penalty based on the casting.

name: Stubborn Object Book
description: The target is fixed in space and can't fall or be moved by any effect except a creature with a Strength equal to or higher than a number based on the casting.

name: Group Healing Book
description: Target regains Stamina based on the casting.

name: Wound Closure Book
description: Target heals a number of wounds based on the casting.

name: Deadspeech Book
description: The target can speak and must answer a number of questions you ask honestly based on the casting. The target has the same intellect it had in life.

name: Alchemist's Tools
description: Required to make crafting rolls for alchemy items.
fine: Fine (500 gc): Alchemy crafting rolls gain a +1 bonus.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,000 gc): Alchemy crafting rolls gain a +2 bonus.

name: Blacksmith's Tools
description: Required to make crafting rolls for blacksmithing items.
fine: Fine (500 gc): Blacksmithing crafting rolls gain a +1 bonus.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,000 gc): Blacksmithing crafting rolls gain a +2 bonus.

name: Enchanter's Tools
description: Required to make crafting rolls for enchanting items.
fine: Fine (500 gc): Enchanting crafting rolls gain a +1 bonus.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,000 gc): Enchanting crafting rolls gain a +2 bonus.

name: Lockpick Set
description: Without this, you take a -1 penalty on tests made to pick locks.
fine: Fine (750 gc): Grants a +1 bonus on tests to pick locks.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,500 gc): Grants a +2 bonus on tests to pick locks.

name: Miner's Pick
description: Great for breaking stones and the occasional skull.

name: Surgical Kit
description: UD 1 (Useless; Activate). Scalpels, threads, needles, and bandages made for closing wounds. You can use this kit when you take the Tend Wounds rest activity to have the target lose 1 additional wound.

name: Cook's Utensils
description: Required for some special rest activities as part of the Travel trait tree.

name: Magnifying Glass
description: Can be used to better inspect the minute visual details of nearby creatures and objects.

name: Merchant's Scales
description: Used to determine the weight of Tiny objects and Tiny creatures that sit still.

name: Musical Instrument
description: A portable musical instrument, like a lute, lyre, mandolin, drum, or fife. To play it, the instrument must occupy both your hand slots.

name: Spyglass
description: Can be used to make things appear 3 times closer.
fine: Fine (500 gc): Makes things appear 6 times closer.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,000 gc): Makes things appear 10 times closer.

name: Mirror
description: A hand mirror, useful for looking around corners and at your own mug.

name: Compass
description: When you make a test related to the guide travel role and carry a compass, the test gains a +1 bonus.
fine: Fine (1,000 gc): The bonus rises to +2.
masterwork: Masterwork (2,000 gc): The bonus rises to +3.

name: Lore Book
description: This book relates to an expertise. Study this book as a rest activity and gain 1 use of that expertise that lasts until your next rest.

name: Animal Feed
description: A day's worth of food for a pet. Must be consumed during a rest to get the benefit of resting.

name: Ball Bearings
description: A bag of 1,000.
maneuver: Spread over a 2x2 area of ground. Creature entering must make an Agility RR.

name: Bear Trap
maneuver: Set this trap on the ground. When a creature steps on the set trap, they take 1d6 dam, and if they are Large or smaller, they are grabbed by the trap. It has 10 Stamina.

name: Block & Tackle
description: Set of 2 hooked pulleys that can be used to lift up to 500 lbs. Rope sold separately.
fine: Fine (500 gc): Lifts up to 1,000 lbs.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,000 gc): Lifts up to 1,500 lbs.

name: Bucket
description: Can hold up to 3 gallons of liquid... also good for hiding your face!

name: Caltrops
description: A bag of 1,000.
maneuver: Spread over a 2x2 area of ground. Creatures entering make an Agility RR.

name: Candle
description: UD 1 (Useless; DT).
maneuver: Light 0/5

name: Card Deck
description: Standard deck of 54 playing cards, including 2 jokers.

name: Chain
description: A 10-foot length of iron chain.

name: Chalk
description: UD 1 (Useless; Activate). A piece of chalk, available in blue, white, and yellow. Use it to mark your way or leave messages on stone.

name: Coin Purse
description: Holds up to 500 coins.
fine: Fine (500 gc): Holds up to 750 gc.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,000 gc): Holds up to 1,000 gc.

name: Cold Weather Gear
description: Used to survive in cold snaps and blizzards. Cold weather gear is considered worn if you want to wear it and it is in a backpack slot.

name: Crafting Material, Bar
description: A metal bar used in crafting. The Ref determines the nature of the crafting material.

name: Crafting Material, Log
description: A wood log used in crafting. The Ref determines the nature of the crafting material.

name: Crowbar
description: An iron bar that can be used in prying.
fine: Fine (750 gc): Gives a +1 bonus on tests that use the crowbar.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,500 gc): Gives a +2 bonus on tests that use the crowbar.

name: Grappling Hook
description: Can be added to rope to create an item that takes up 2 slots. Makes hurling and securing rope easier.

name: Holy Symbol
description: A symbol of your god. Can be worn in the neck slot, but isn't magic.

name: Journal
description: A bound journal of 200 blank pages.

name: Lantern
description: UD 2 (Refuel w oil; DT).
maneuver: Light 10/10

name: Net
description: This fishing net unfurls when hurled. You can hurl it at a Medium or smaller creature as part of the Grab maneuver, which gives you an edge on the test, and gives them a bane on tests made to break the grab. It has 5 Stamina.

name: Padlock
description: Iron padlock. Includes a key.
fine: Fine (750 gc): Tests to pick or break the lock take a -1 penalty.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,500 gc): Tests to pick or break the lock take a -2 penalty.

name: Pitons
description: Iron spikes that can be hammered into stone and used to secure ropes. Come in multiples of 10.

name: Pot
description: Iron pot for cooking. Makes great scrambled eggs and soup! Comes with a heavy lid.

name: Quill & Inkpot
description: For writing stuff down!

name: Ration
description: A day's worth of food. Can be consumed to avoid starvation and get the benefits of a rest.

name: Rope
description: 50 feet of rope. If secured, no test is required to climb.
fine: Fine (500 gc): 100 feet of strong, light rope.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,000 gc): 150 feet of strong, light rope.

name: Shovel
description: Use this to dig holes! Can also make a decent crowbar in a pinch, but might break.

name: Soap
description: UD 1 (Useless; Activate). You can use this bar of soap to clean yourself or a mess, leave messages, whittle shapes, or lubricate locks, tools, or your wrists when bound in chains.

name: String
description: 1,000 feet of string.

name: Torch
description: UD 1 (Useless; DT).
maneuver: Light 5/5

name: Whistle
maneuver: Create a loud noise that can be heard from 20 squares away.

name: Tent
description: This waterproof canvas tent sleeps up to 4 humans comfortably. You can use this to wait out bad weather.

name: Ladder
maneuver: The ladder expands 10 feet.
fine: Fine (500 gc): The ladder expands 20 feet.
masterwork: Masterwork (1,000 gc): The ladder expands 30 feet.

name: 11-Foot Pole
description: An 11-foot-long wooden pole. For poking. Also prodding! Tie some string on it to make a fishing rod!

name: Magic Ring
description: Try it on. It'll feel like your big day!

name: Magic Wand
description: What does it do? C'mon just activate it. You know you wanna.

name: Potion
description: Just drink it. What's the worst that could happen?

name: Art Object, Tiny
description: A valuable treasure. Specific work of art and value are determined by the Ref.

name: Art Object, Small
description: A valuable treasure. Specific work of art and value are determined by the Ref.

name: Art Object, Medium
description: A valuable treasure. Specific work of art and value are determined by the Ref.

name: Gem
description: A shiny rock. Exact gem type and value are determined by the Ref.

name: Monster Part
description: A piece of a monster.
